nodes.name: Precursor Synthesis
nodes.procedure: The ZIF-67 is synthesized as a precursor. ZIF-67 has micro-cube morphology.
nodes.source_text: First, the ZIF-67 is synthesized as a precursor ... surface is relatively flat

nodes.name: Yolk-Shell Formation
nodes.procedure: YS-CeO2/ZIF-67 is then obtained by a solvothermal reaction of ZIF-67, HMT and Ce3+ solution. Ce ions and HMT serve as an etchant and a sustained release agent, respectively, synergistically coordinating the formation of the yolk-shell structure.

unit_operations.name: Solvothermal treatment
unit_operations.procedure_snippet: YS- CeO2/ZIF - 67 is then obtained by a solvothermal reaction of ZIF-67, HMT and Ce3+ solution.

nodes.source_text: YS- CeO2/ZIF - 67 is then obtained by a solvothermal reaction of ZIF-67, HMT and Ce3+ solution ... synergistically coordinating the formation of the yolk-shell structure.

nodes.name: Dissolution-Redeposition Hollowing
nodes.procedure: YS-CeO2/ZIF-67 is reacted with Ni2+ under the ultrasound and transformed into DS CeO2/NiCo LDH. Protons released by the hydrolysis of Ni2+ trigger the dissolution-redeposition of Co2+ and Ni2+ to produce NiCo hydroxide.

unit_operations.name: Ultrasonication
unit_operations.procedure_snippet: YS - CeO2 / ZIF - 67 is reacted with Ni2 + under the ultrasound and transformed into DS CeO2 / NiCo LDH.

nodes.source_text: YS - CeO2 / ZIF - 67 is reacted with Ni2 + under the ultrasound and transformed into DS CeO2 / NiCo LDH. In this process, protons released by the hydrolysis of Ni2 + trigger the dissolution-redeposition of Co2 + and Ni2 + to produce NiCo hydroxide.

nodes.name: Control Sample Synthesis
nodes.procedure: Single-shelled (SS-) NiCo LDH is synthesized through the same method but using ZIF-67 to react with Ni2+ under ultrasonic.

nodes.characterization_summary: Raman spectra identify CeO2 vibration at 465 cm-1 and Co-O symmetric stretching at 530 cm-1; a defect-induced mode at 600 cm-1 is noted for the composite.
nodes.evidence_snippet: The band at 465 cm-1 includes F2g symmetry vibration mode of CeO2 ... the band at 530 cm-1 can be assigned to the Co-O ( Ag ) symmetric stretching ... vibration at 600 cm-1 is not observed in Raman spectra of commercial CeO2 and SS-NiCo LDH

nodes.characterization_summary: XPS confirms Ni 2p3/2 and Co 2p3/2 peaks at 856.1 and 781.6 eV; O 1s peaks indicate abundant oxygen vacancies at 531.5 eV.
nodes.evidence_snippet: Ni 2p and Co 2p spectra exhibit peaks of 856.1 and 781.6 eV ... The larger portion of the peak at 531.5 eV indicates abundant oxygen vacancies in DS - CeO2 / NiCo LDH

nodes.characterization_summary: Ni K-edge XANES suggests the introduction of CeO2 does not significantly change the valence of Ni.
nodes.evidence_snippet: Ni K-edge position in the X-ray absorption near-edge spectroscopy (XANES), the introduction of CeO2 does not vary the valence of Ni markedly

nodes.characterization_summary: EXAFS fitting shows Ni-O(H) octahedron is intact (coordination ~5.78) but the second shell Ni/Co coordination decreases to 5.23 due to defects/interfaces.
nodes.evidence_snippet: The fitting results reveal ... the degeneracy of the second coordination shell decreases from 5.95 in SS-NiCo LDH to 5.23 in DS - CeO2 / NiCo LDH

properties.technique: Wavelet Transform Extended X-ray Absorption Fine Structure
properties.description: 2D contour plots showing the radial distribution and momentum space information of the local atomic environment.

nodes.characterization_summary: Potential-dependent EIS shows a significant decrease in Rct for DS-CeO2/NiCo LDH, especially before the OER onset, indicating accelerated kinetics.
nodes.evidence_snippet: the region before the OER onset potential also shows a more pronounced decline in the Rct of DS - CeO2 / NiCo LDH than SS-NiCo LDH

nodes.characterization_summary: In situ ATR-IR identifies intermediates *OH (3400 cm-1), metal-oxygen (1660 cm-1), and *OOH (1230 cm-1), showing higher coverage on DS-CeO2/NiCo LDH.
nodes.evidence_snippet: Bands 3400 1660,and 1230 cm-1 can be classified as the stretching of adsorbed hydroxyl (*OH) ... metal-oxygen intermediates and O-O stretching mode of surface-adsorbed superoxide (*OOH)

nodes.characterization_summary: In situ 18O isotope-labeling DEMS shows low oxygen exchange between the lattice and environment, indicating the adsorbate evolution mechanism (AEM).
nodes.evidence_snippet: in situ 18O isotope-labeling differential electrochemical mass spectroscopy (DEMS) exhibit few OER products ... indicating that oxygen exchange between hydroxide lattice and external environment is relative low

nodes.characterization_summary: EQCM reveals a mass-charge ratio of 1.9 g/mol e- for the alpha-Ni(OH)2 to gamma-NiOOH transition and 11.6 g/mol e- for OH- adsorption/K+ departure.
nodes.evidence_snippet: For DS - CeO2 / NiCo LDH ... The mass-charge ratio is 11.6 g mol-1 e- ascribe to the departure of K+ from the outer surface and the adsorption of OH- driven by the charge compensation

nodes.characterization_summary: ICP-OES confirms the presence of Ni, Co, and Ce, supporting the specific activity calculations for the hydroxide phase.
nodes.evidence_snippet: confirmed by inductively coupled plasma optical emission spectrometry (ICP-OES, Table S3, Supporting Information).

nodes.characterization_summary: FTIR shows a peak at 1384 cm-1 attributed to interlayer NO3- ions from the synthesis process.
nodes.evidence_snippet: Fourier-transform infrared spectroscopy (FTIR) present a characteristic peak at 1384 cm-1 ... ascribed to the interlayer NO3- originated from nitrate-involved dissolution-redeposition process.

nodes.characterization_summary: EDS mapping and linear distribution show Ce in the outer shell and Ni/Co in the inner shell, confirming the double-shelled structure.
nodes.evidence_snippet: According to elemental mapping images and linear distributions as shown in Figure 1e, Ce is mainly distributed in the outer shell while the inner shell elements are mainly Ni and Co.
